established: The fresh Nexus executor repository reproduces the hosted-runner failure before any workflow step executes.
The provider-free canary reproduces the failure twice without checkout, third-party actions, repository secrets, Cloudflare credentials, or Modal credentials.
Both canary attempts completed with runner_id=0 and an empty step list.
The Cloudflare and Modal workflows also fail before any step executes, so their provider credentials and scripts are not reached.
The candidate and sealed authority branches were not modified by this executor work.
No Axiom repository, runner, credential, storage, verifier, or infrastructure was used.
not_established: A specific GitHub billing, spending-limit, policy, entitlement, or account-state cause.
external_boundary: GitHub must assign a usable executor substrate for the Nexus workflows, or a directly authorized Nexus Modal/Cloudflare execution connection must be available. Until then, provider code cannot be exercised and no gate credit can be claimed.
